items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Johnny and I left the band and we were joined by Al Sears in New York. And we had the nucleus of a very nice little group.

ctx.x: Did -- Al [Sully] wasn't terribly popular with the members of the band was he?

I -- he was all right as far as I know except that -- money was so tight in those days that everybody -- you know how you blame the manager for not giving you this and that and everything. It isn't his fault really. I got along very well with Al. Very well, and he was a valuable man in some ways.
I know Duke said he knew how to deal with the kinds of people in the band -- the night clubs --
